detail.longDescription: In this day and age where storage media is incredibly overpriced (thanks AI...), maybe you have some older storage just lying around. Maybe as a single drive it seems too small. That's where something like this Terramaster D8 Hybrid 2 enclosure comes in. it gave me a chance to combine a lot of the storage I already owned. Check it out. https:// youtu.be/Hws8M_KY1rg # opensource # selfhosted # storage # terramaster
